question: Should CodexBar ship a Phase 1 lower-bound usage estimate that stops multiplicative inflation but knowingly omits legitimate usage and leaves cross-file reconciliation unresolved?
rationale: This changes the accuracy contract of user-visible cost reporting, so tests alone cannot determine whether the tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Require scan-wide provenance and preservation of legitimate smaller-lineage usage before landing.

options.title: Accept an interim lower bound
options.body: Merge only after explicit approval, disclosure, and redacted corpus measurements quantify the remaining undercount.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Defer or close this draft until a sanitized fixture enables a complete accounting design.

recommendation.title: Redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Require scan-wide provenance and preservation of legitimate smaller-lineage usage before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the released scanner baseline and the recent revert that set the architecture and validation expectations for this issue.
